name: Drawing My Life
source: For years you have lived your life alone, enjoying the freedom, drinking with friends, having sex without commitments, flexible jobs... Until the daily life of your new neighbors begin to remind you of a past you have tried to erase from your life. To make matters worse, it seems like a part of your past is about to return to your life. Will you be able to deal with the whole situation?
translation: 多年来，你一直独自生活，享受自由，与朋友喝酒，没有承诺的性行为，灵活的工作……直到你的新邻居的日常生活开始让你想起你试图从生活中抹去的过去。更糟糕的是，你过去的一部分似乎即将回到你的生活中。你能处理好整个情况吗？
